games.title: Midnight Broker
games.coverAlt: The Night Broker, a masked ghost with a katana, in front of red lanterns
games.blurb: A 5×4 cluster slot set in a lantern-lit night market. Every win lights its cells, and when the Night Broker drifts in, every lit lantern flips open for cash or a multiplier.
games.lead: A 5×4 cluster slot in a lantern-lit night market. Every win lights its cells, and when the Night Broker lands, every lit lantern flips open for cash or a multiplier.

steps.title: Light the cells.
steps.text: Winning clusters light the cells they sat on.

steps.title: The Broker collects.
steps.text: Lit lanterns reveal 0.2x to 500x, or ×2 and ×3 multipliers.

steps.title: Break the seals.
steps.text: 3, 4 or 5 Seals open the Regular, Super or Mystery bonus.

bonuses.name: Regular Bonus
bonuses.text: 8 spins. Lit cells stay lit for the whole bonus. 3 Seals add 4 more spins.

bonuses.name: Super Bonus
bonuses.text: 10 spins with 6 cells lit from the start, and every collection pays at least ×3.

bonuses.name: Mystery Bonus
bonuses.text: 10 spins with 4 cells lit from the start. Reached only with 5 Seals or from a Mystery Bonus buy.

modes.name: Feature Spins
modes.note: The Broker on every board, 6 smaller lanterns lit

modes.name: Moonlit Spins
modes.note: All 20 cells lit, every collect at least ×10

games.finePrint: Figures are from the current math build and may change before release. Some modes are not available in every jurisdiction.

games.title: Noble Seal
games.coverAlt: A seal in a knight's helmet and red cape, raising a sword over a market town at sunset
games.blurb: A 6×5 lines slot in a storybook market town. Royal Seals fill whole reels with wilds and multipliers up to 1000x, and in free spins they stick and grow.
games.lead: A 6×5 lines slot in a storybook market town. Royal Seals fill whole reels with wilds and multipliers up to 1000x, and in free spins they stick and grow every spin.

steps.title: Line up 3 or more.
steps.text: 3 to 6 of a symbol on a line, from the first reel, pay.

steps.title: Land a Royal Seal.
steps.text: It fills its reel with wilds and a 2x to 1000x multiplier. Lines through several add them up.

steps.title: Collect FS scatters.
steps.text: 3, 4 or 5 and more start the Royal, Super or Epic bonus.

bonuses.name: Royal Seal Spins
bonuses.text: 10 free spins on a clear board. Royal Seals that land stick to their reels and grow +1 every spin.

bonuses.name: Super Royal Seal Spins
bonuses.text: 12 free spins, starting with a Royal Seal locked in place.

bonuses.name: Epic Royal Seal Spins
bonuses.text: 12 free spins, starting with 2 Royal Seals locked in place.

games.bonusNote: 3 or more FS scatters during a bonus add 5 more free spins.

modes.name: Extra Chance
modes.note: A much better chance of a bonus

modes.name: Super Chance
modes.note: A better chance of Super or Epic

modes.name: Feature Spin
modes.note: 3 Royal Seals of 10x or more on every spin

games.finePrint: Figures are from the current math build and may change before release. Some modes are not available in every jurisdiction.
